messages:
Leah: alerting — small-infer pods SLOs are degrading in us-west1a since 01:12. tons of 1GPU pods stuck Pending, then getting Preempted. looks like a packing anomaly.
Sam: can you dump scheduler events and warm pool counts?
Leah: quick summary: warmpool size collapsed from 160 -> 28 over ~14m. events are `FailedAttach` then `Preempted`. NVLink error rate up on rack-11 and rack-12.
Ibrahim: we shipped shallow-packing v2 last night; it groups by a loose sequence-window to avoid excessive fragmentation. telemetry shows it accidentally clamped many small 1GPU low-seq replicas onto NVLink racks to chase throughput. that created hotspot racks and starvation elsewhere.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west1a warmpool depletion at 1759994570. impacted: ~73 tiny pods, preemptions: 142.
Sam: immediate ops: 1) rollback shallow-packing v2 (Ibrahim) 2) increase warmpool.min for us-west1a to 190 (infra) 3) apply a temporary admission mutator to tag `pack.hint=small` on pods with gpu==1 and seq_len < 512 (fast).
Ibrahim: rolling back shallow-packing now (commit f9c3b) — should take ~7m. also going to add a quick guard to the packer to avoid >60% long-seq concentration per rack.
Leah: infra, patching warmpool: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1a -p '{"spec":{"minSize":190}}'`
NetOps: we see conntrack queues rising on top-of-rack switches for racks 11/12; attach latency there is 2-3x normal. we'll drain r11 and rotate.
infra-bot: ACTION: rollback triggered at 1759994585. warmpool.minSize updated at 1759994592.
Sam: mutator script (applying):
```
# pseudo-mutator
if pod.resources.gpu == 1 and int(pod.annotations.get('seq_len','0')) < 512:
  pod.labels['pack.hint']='small'
```
Applying now.
Ibrahim: early signals look good: pending queue shrinking, admissions for tiny pods resumed. rack hotspot errors falling but conntrack drain in progress.
Leah: I also see a subset of pods that were bounced multiple times (attach timeout -> reschedule -> preempt). adding a backoff on attach retries for small pods would help.
SRE Oncall: follow-ups: 1) expose per-rack `seq_len_ratio` in telemetry 2) make `pack.hint` a scheduler-aware preference 3) implement attach-retry-backoff for latency-sensitive small pods 4) network to rotate/rehab r11/r12.
NetOps: starting rack drain for r11 now. ETA 20m.
Ibrahim: opening PR for packer spill policy and the 60% cap: github.com/redwood/packers/pull/1345.
Leah: filing incident ticket with traces and grep outputs. adding runbook note: if warmpool < 30% baseline, set minSize to baseline+25% and deploy small-pod mutator.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warmpool recovered and preempt rate returned to baseline at 1759994680.
Sam: thanks everyone. let's review packer heuristics in tomorrow's slot to avoid repeating this. :thumbsup:
